title: VINFAST PHILIPPINES INTRODUCES VF 3 PLUS AND VF 3 ECO, BRINGING MORE STYLE AND CHOICE TO A NEW GENERATION OF CUSTOMERS
summary: Manila, November 13, 2026 - VinFast officially introduces the VF 3 Plus and VF 3 Eco in the Philippines, adding technology, safety and convenience features to the country’s best-selling battery electric vehicle. Notably, the VF 3 Plus offers a more premium option for a new generation of customers seeking a fully equipped driving experience from day one.
body_markdown:
***Manila, November 13, 2026 - VinFast officially introduces the VF 3 Plus and VF 3 Eco in the Philippines, adding technology, safety and convenience features to the country’s best-selling battery electric vehicle. Notably, the VF 3 Plus offers a more premium option for a new generation of customers seeking a fully equipped driving experience from day one.***


Compared with the Base version, the VF 3 Plus and VF 3 Eco introduce upgrades to in-cabin technology and safety, offering greater convenience, flexibility and peace of mind on every journey. Both variants come standard with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, Bluetooth connectivity for calls and media, an integrated microphone, and multifunction steering wheel controls. Second-row ISOFIX anchor points have also been added for compatible child seats.


The VF 3 Plus adds factory-fitted power-adjustable and power-folding side mirrors, a rearview camera and wheel covers. These additions enhance the vehicle’s appearance while making city driving and parking more convenient, giving customers more ways to express their personal style.


Both new variants retain the VF 3’s compact dimensions, with an overall length of 3,190 mm, a range of 215 km on a full charge under the NEDC standard, and support for DC fast charging at up to 24 kW. The VF 3 Eco aims to make electric mobility accessible to more consumers, while the VF 3 Plus caters to customers seeking additional equipment and convenience, broadening the choices available across the lineup.


The VinFast VF 3 electric mini-SUV has attracted strong demand in the Philippines. According to data from the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines, Inc. (CAMPI), the VF 3 was the country’s best-selling battery electric vehicle from January to August 2026. Rising demand in the first half of the year prompted VinFast to replenish inventory of the Base version and laid the foundation for further expanding customer choice with the VF 3 Plus and VF 3 Eco. Customers can place pre-orders for both new variants through all authorized VinFast dealerships in the Philippines.


Mr. Antonio “Toti” Zara III, CEO of VinFast Philippines, said:


*“The strong response to the VinFast VF 3 reflects growing demand among Filipino consumers for accessible electric mini-SUVs and reinforces our position as a leading choice for battery electric vehicles in the market. As the ‘Tiny Titan’ continues to win over Filipino drivers, we are excited to expand the lineup with the VF 3 Plus and VF 3 Eco in November, bringing our customers more choice, features and value, all backed by VinFast’s comprehensive and reliable ownership system.”*


Alongside its expanding product lineup, VinFast continues to develop a comprehensive electric vehicle ecosystem in the Philippines, encompassing its dealership network, battery subscription and Residual Value Guarantee programs, charging infrastructure, and aftersales services. Through these efforts, the company is steadily addressing barriers to electric vehicle ownership and use, helping consumers make the transition to green mobility with greater convenience and confidence.
